support_tickets.description: Tickets end to end: list and filter, create for a customer, properties (status, priority, agent, product), tags, watchers, close and re-open, merge and split, bulk actions, custom fields, time tracking, and the FluentCRM, FluentBooking and FluentBoards links on a ticket.

support_replies.description: Ticket conversations: replies and internal notes, drafts and draft approval, scheduled replies, bulk replies, saved reply templates, and AI reply drafts, summaries and tone.
support_replies.note: AI, scheduled replies and bulk replies need Fluent Support Pro.

support_customers.description: Support customers: find and search, create, update, custom fields, avatars, bulk status changes and deletes.

support_agents.description: Support staff: agents and their permissions, agent groups, and the signed-in agent's notifications.

support_mailboxes.description: Business mailboxes (inboxes): CRUD, default mailbox, email notification settings, moving tickets between mailboxes, and email piping status and push endpoints.

support_workflows.description: Automation workflows: triggers, conditions and action sequences, duplication, run history, and manual runs on selected tickets.

support_reports.description: Read-only reporting: overall and per-agent stats, the agent dashboard, ticket and response growth, advanced reports and snapshots, timesheets, and the activity logs.

support_products.description: Products tickets are filed under, and the ticket tags used to classify them.

support_settings.description: Global settings: business settings, integrations (FluentCRM, AI provider, cloud uploads, incoming webhook, remote portal), the ticket form, auto-close, activity logging, the Pro license, portal setup and the site-side MCP adapter.

support_portal.description: The customer-facing side: the customer portal's ticket endpoints (act as the signed-in customer), portal sign-up and login, and the remote portal connection.
support_portal.note: customer-portal and auth endpoints run under the portal session policy: with an admin Application Password they act as that user's customer record (none for a pure admin), and signup/login/two_fa/reset_pass check the portal's own nonce, so most are rejected outside a browser.

support_utilities.description: Maintenance and plumbing: REST connectivity tests, cron and database health, log cleanup, the ticket importer, report data audits, and the public token-authenticated receivers for incoming webhooks, chat replies and OAuth callbacks.

tickets/merge-tickets.bodyNote: Irreversible: the merged tickets' responses move into this ticket and the source tickets are closed. Requires confirm:true.

tickets/split-ticket.bodyNote: Moves a response out of this ticket into a newly created ticket. Requires confirm:true.

tickets/bulk-action-tickets.bodyNote: Body: {"bulk_action": "close_tickets"|"delete_tickets"|"reopen_tickets"|"assign_agent"|"assign_agent_group"|"assign_tags"|"remove_tags"|"change_priority"|"change_product", "ticket_ids": [...], plus the action's value (agent_id, tag_ids, priority, product_id)}.

responses/bulk-reply.summary: Send One Reply to Many Tickets (mass send)

agents/create-agent.bodyNote: Privilege change: grants a WordPress user support-agent access and permissions. Requires confirm:true.

agents/update-agent.bodyNote: Privilege change: can change an agent's role and permissions. Requires confirm:true.

mailboxes/move-mailbox-tickets.summary: Move All of a Mailbox's Tickets to Another Mailbox (mass move)

workflows/run-workflow.summary: Run a Manual Workflow on Selected Tickets (executes its actions)

ticket-importer/import-tickets.summary: Import Tickets from Another Helpdesk (mass create)

settings/setup-portal.summary: Run the Portal Setup (creates the portal page and rewrites page settings)

settings/install-fluentcrm.bodyNote: Installs plugin code (wordpress.org fluent-crm) on the site. Requires confirm:true.

settings/toggle-mcp.bodyNote: Privilege/code change: Enables/disables the site-side MCP adapter (a second AI control surface). Requires confirm:true.

settings/create-remote-portal-connection.bodyNote: Mints a standing connection credential for a remote portal. Requires confirm:true.

remote-portal/rotate-remote-portal-token.bodyNote: Invalidates the current remote portal token and issues a new one; the remote site must be reconnected. Requires confirm:true.
